sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value to a function transfers ownership and makes the original binding unusable.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away cannot be spent again by the one who gave it.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a nil channel blocks forever because no sender can ever be connected to it.
sketches.resonance: Waiting on a bond that was never made becomes an endless suspension.

sketches.mechanism: Default argument values are evaluated once at function definition time, so a mutable default preserves state across calls.
sketches.resonance: A place meant to begin empty secretly remembers everyone who has passed through it.

def keep(x=[]):
    x.append(None)
    return x

first = keep()
again = keep()
assert first is again
